name: cascade-project-management
description: Define tracker-ready work items and plan or coordinate evidence-bound projects and lean Agile MVP delivery without taking product priority, filing, or target execution authority.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, coordinate, reconcile, and close projects.
interface.longDescription: Draft grounded issues, stories, and tasks; create lean project or Agile MVP plans across versions and iterations; coordinate dependency-bound work; reconcile stale project state; and propose evidence-preserving closeout while leaving strategy, filing, and execution with their owners.
defaultPrompt: Draft one grounded tracker-ready issue, story, or task from this evidence.
Turn this initiative into a lean project or Agile MVP plan.
Reconcile or close this project without losing evidence.
